name: QuoteMate Customer Knowledge Base
description: Customer-facing help content for QuoteMate, structured for support agents and for ingestion by a retrieval-augmented (RAG) chatbot.
audience: QuoteMate users (Australian tradies) and prospective customers browsing the website. Not the homeowners who receive quotes.

source_of_truth.pricing: Free $0 (unlimited quotes/invoices) / Pro Monthly $49 / Pro Annual $328
source_of_truth.free_trial: 14 days, starts on first quote creation

documents.title: What is QuoteMate?
documents.summary: Product overview: an AI quoting and invoicing app for Australian tradies. What it does, who it's for, Australian focus, the Mate beta assistant.

documents.title: Create your account and set up your business
documents.summary: Sign up by email, Google, or Apple; email verification; the 6-step onboarding (company, trade, contact/ABN, branding, rates, payments).
question_examples: Can I log in with Google or Apple?
Do I need a credit card to sign up?

documents.title: Quick start — send your first quote
documents.summary: The fastest path to sending a first quote, plus the note that the 14-day trial starts on first quote.
question_examples: How do I send my first quote?
What's the quickest way to make a quote?

documents.title: Supported platforms, devices, and offline use
documents.summary: iOS, Android, and web; one subscription across devices; offline-first with auto-sync; Tap to Pay device requirements; mobile-only features.
question_examples: What devices does it work on?
Can I use it on the web?

documents.title: Trades QuoteMate supports
documents.summary: 24+ supported trades and the trade-specific touches for electricians, plumbers/gasfitters, and tilers.
keywords: does it work for my trade

documents.title: Creating a quote
documents.summary: The quoting flow (details, customer, materials, pricing, preview), section-based quoting, and sending by email/SMS/WhatsApp.
question_examples: How do I create a quote?
Can I split a quote into sections?
How do I send a quote?

documents.title: How AI material suggestions work
documents.summary: Describe a job in plain English to get suggested materials and quantities; everything is editable; AI generation is a Pro feature.
question_examples: How does the AI quoting work?
Do I have to enter every material myself?

documents.title: Live supplier pricing and your trade rates
documents.summary: The price-priority chain (your data first), importing supplier price lists, saving trade rates, and fixing 'no prices found'.
question_examples: How does live supplier pricing work?
Can I use my own trade rates?
Why does it say no prices found?

documents.title: Job templates and section templates
documents.summary: Built-in job templates (deck, fence, pergola, stairs) and reusable saved section templates for repeat work.
question_examples: Can I save a section and reuse it?

documents.title: GST, labour, markup, and travel
documents.summary: Automatic 10% GST, labour hours/days and rate, separate materials/labour markup, and a travel adjustment with fuel estimator.

documents.title: Invoices and converting a quote to an invoice
documents.summary: One-tap quote-to-invoice (idempotent, no duplicates), creating invoices directly, deposits, partial payments, and invoice statuses.
question_examples: How do I turn a quote into an invoice?

documents.title: Payment methods your customers can use
documents.summary: Square, card, cash, cheque on all plans; bank transfer, PayID, BPAY, PayPal on Pro.
question_examples: What ways can my customers pay?
Do you support PayID and BPAY?

documents.title: Getting paid with Square (Tap to Pay, fees, payouts)
documents.summary: Canonical fees doc. Tap to Pay requirements, online links, the fee table (Free 1.7% vs Pro 1.0% online / 1.5% in-person), 2.9% surcharge passthrough, next-day payouts, refunds via Square.
question_examples: How do I take card payments on-site?
How long until the money hits my account?

documents.title: Tracking payments and chasing unpaid invoices
documents.summary: Invoice statuses, automatic overdue detection, automated invoice reminders and quote follow-ups, receipts, and GST logging for BAS.
question_examples: Can I track which invoices are paid?

documents.title: Managing jobs and the pipeline
documents.summary: The 9-stage job pipeline, scheduling, on-site photos with annotation, checklists, and follow-ups. Conservative note on Google Calendar sync.
question_examples: Can I manage jobs after the quote is sent?

documents.title: Xero integration
documents.summary: Connect Xero via OAuth, choose organisation, push invoices in one tap, auto-create contacts, bulk sync, CSV export.

documents.title: Reece maX integration
documents.summary: Live Reece maX integration: connect via OAuth, trade-rate pricing refreshed nightly, order to Reece from an accepted quote, on by default for plumbers/gasfitters, no extra cost.
question_examples: Can I order from Reece inside the app?

documents.title: Connecting Square for payments
documents.summary: How to connect Square (onboarding or Settings), OAuth, needing a Square account on your ABN, and what you can do after connecting. Fees live in the getting-paid doc.
question_examples: Do I need a Square account?

documents.title: Google Calendar integration
documents.summary: Connect Google Calendar in Settings. Conservative on automatic job sync pending verification.
question_examples: Do scheduled jobs show on my calendar?

documents.title: CallKatie (call answering partner)
documents.summary: Third-party call-answering partner surfaced in the app, billed separately (from $149/mo). Not a QuoteMate-built feature.

documents.title: Plans and pricing
documents.summary: Free (unlimited quotes/invoices) vs Pro ($49/mo, $328/yr). What each plan includes; one subscription across devices.
question_examples: What's the difference between Free and Pro?

documents.title: Free trial — how it works
documents.summary: 14-day Pro trial starting on first quote, no card needed, and what happens when it ends.
question_examples: How does the free trial work?
What happens when the trial ends?

documents.title: Managing, upgrading, and cancelling your subscription
documents.summary: Upgrade in-app; billed via App Store / Google Play / Stripe by platform; cancel any time and keep Pro to period end; GST-inclusive AUD.
question_examples: How do I upgrade to Pro?

documents.title: Business profile, logo, and branding
documents.summary: Set business name, ABN, contact details, brand colour, and logo; branding on PDFs (logo is a Pro feature); defaults and rates.
question_examples: How do I add my logo?
Can I put my ABN on quotes?

documents.title: Data security and privacy
documents.summary: Firebase storage, encryption in transit and at rest, Australian Privacy Act compliance, AI processing note, 30-day deletion.
question_examples: How do I delete my account?

documents.title: Troubleshooting common issues
documents.summary: Fixes for 'no prices found', login/email verification, sync, refunds via Square, web vs mobile differences, and how to contact support.
question_examples: It says no prices found — what do I do?

documents.title: Frequently asked questions
documents.summary: Short answers to the most common customer questions, each linking to the full article. Good quick-answer chunks for a chatbot.
